questions.stem: A student adds a respiratory inhibitor to root cells. What would you expect to happen to mineral ion uptake?

options.text: Mineral uptake would increase because more energy is available
Mineral uptake would decrease because active transport requires energy from respiration
Mineral uptake would stay the same because it occurs by osmosis
Mineral uptake would stop but water uptake would also stop completely

questions.explanation: Mineral ions are absorbed by active transport, which requires ATP from respiration. If respiration is inhibited, less ATP is available, so active transport slows down and mineral uptake decreases. Water uptake by osmosis would be less affected as it is a passive process.
